reply:
Good afternoon Chidi,

I've looked into this carefully before resending anything, because resending now would risk a double payment.

Our system shows transfer TRF-INV-88 (₦250,000 to Access Bank 0234567891) as failed, which matches what you saw. However, when I asked Access Bank directly for the final status, they confirmed the funds WERE credited to the recipient account:

- Status: Success — "Credited to the recipient account"
- Date/time: 21 November 2026, 14:02 UTC
- Session ID: 000014261121140211000088

Because the recipient bank confirms the credit, I have held off on resending the ₦250,000 to avoid paying you twice.

Please take the session ID above to Access Bank (or check your account statement for 21 November) and ask them to trace the credit. If the funds genuinely are not in your account after that trace, reply here and I'll escalate to our team to investigate the discrepancy and arrange payment straight away.
